name: Ramsay Générale de Santé SA
summary: Ramsay Générale de Santé SA operates healthcare facilities in France, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Italy. It provides preventive care, primary medicine, medicine surgery obstetrics, oncology, medical imaging, medical care and rehabilitation, home hospitalization, mental health care and addiction treatment, geriatrics, tele monitoring and e health services; and operates medical centres, and mental health day care centres. The company was formerly known as Générale de Santé SA and changed its name to Ramsay Générale de Santé SA in December 2015.
